content_html: I'm Sharat, co-founder of Jamb (jamb.ai, crunchbase.com/organization/j…) Jamb is a system of record for construction teams. 4 out of 5 US residential builders are made up of small teams (1-4 employees). The general contractor is often one person who runs the job from a truck, on calls all day. That person rarely stops to open a project tool and fill in a form. The data already exists. It sits inside the phone calls. So we put a voice agent in the calls and the group chats. Her name is Donna. She turns speech into tasks, a call summary and an attributed transcript. The record updates from the call, not from a form. She is also the AI receptionist on your business line. Thread (1/n): Demos from what we showed at Boston's Voice AI meetup. We show a three-way phone call where the agent listens quietly and speaks only when summoned. Three more demos show Donna managing tasks, recalling details from previous calls and chats, and acting as an interpreter. Event: luma.com/gqxuajjg?tk=oj… Slides: docs.google.com/presentation/d…
